subject.title: Gateway memory growth due to repeated file read errors

question: Should this be fixed by correcting the scheduled producer/prompt that emits stale workspace paths, or by expanding the generic read tool to list directories and tolerate more path aliases?
rationale: Source inspection shows partial fixes but leaves an unresolved contract choice: producer-specific repair is narrow, while changing read-tool directory behavior affects all model-facing reads.

options.title: Prefer producer-specific repair
options.body: Reproduce the scheduled run, fix the heartbeat/cron/memory producer that emits invalid paths, and keep generic read semantics unchanged unless separately approved.

options.title: Change read-tool semantics
options.body: Make read-on-directory return a listing and define the new tool contract with tests across read/list callers before treating the issue as fixed.

options.title: Keep diagnostics-only for now
options.body: Leave code unchanged until a maintainer or reporter provides current RSS diagnostics that isolate the retained allocations.

recommendation.title: Prefer producer-specific repair
recommendation.body: Reproduce the scheduled run, fix the heartbeat/cron/memory producer that emits invalid paths, and keep generic read semantics unchanged unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-surface history across the read, cron, and heartbeat files needed for the contract decision.
